IS_PHYSICAL_EXCLUSION_TOKEN_REQUIRED_BY_: NO_EXACT_TOKEN_REQUIRED; prior draft proposed exclusion but no selected physical mechanism
ACQUISITION_AUTHORITY: HEALTH_GUARD initiates signed observation challenge; dedicated READ_PROXY owns read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction
ACQUISITION_PRECONDITION: Exact qualified reader/codec/source identity, current generation/registry and mutation-observer continuity; no pending authority transition
SNAPSHOT_BINDING: Canonical snapshot digest + session birth + transaction snapshot identity + guard challenge + start/end mutation revision + exact source/schema/projection/codec/generation/context
MUTATION_EPOCH_OR_EQUIVALENT: Monotonic independently observed native-relevant authority mutation sequence; complete coverage of DDL/roles/ACL/defaults/config/credential/reader-state mutations mandatory; no MVCC transaction ID assumed universal mutation counter
VALID_STATE: Complete snapshot and equal independently observed start/end mutation revision, exact session/generation/registry continuous, no intervening relevant transition through final conditional publication
INVALID_STATE: Any relevant mutation, observer gap, mismatch, partial read or reconnect => INVALID or UNKNOWN, never qualify
LOSS_DETECTION: Independent observer progress lease exact versioned policy; missing heartbeat/sequencegap denies
INVALIDATION_AUTHORITY: HEALTH_GUARD invalidates work before observed mutation can authorize successor generation; writer serializes final qualification publication against mutation revision
RELEASE_RULE: End read-only transaction after complete result or rollback/discard on any error; release does not grant qualification
CRASH_RULE: Retain pendingUNKNOWN, discard partial snapshot; no prior safe outcome inferred
TIMEOUT_RULE: Versioned positive bounded observation lease; overflow/missing policy => no acquisition
RECONNECT_RULE: Discard entire snapshot, new session requires fresh challenge
RESTART_RULE: Discard old session/observer continuity; independent new generation before acquisition
CONCURRENT_MUTATION_RULE: If complete mutation observation/order cannot establish valid revision at final publication =>UNKNOWN; repeatable-read consistency alone does not prove authority currentness
remaining_static_subcondition: Exact source-bound complete mutation event coverage and publication linearization interface still needed; naming mutation sequence alone cannot prove every relevant event observed.
